_comment: Gym exercise library: written for Cadence in our own words (general technique cues of the kind found in NSCA Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning and ACSM guidance; not copied from any source or dataset). Technique notes, not medical advice. Patterns are the same categories as exercises.json. family+level form the easier/harder ladder.
equipment_note: equipment is a list of alternatives; each alternative is the list of items needed together (any one alternative is enough). Bodyweight needs nothing.

exercises.name: Box Squat
cues: Stand in front of a sturdy box or bench, feet shoulder-width.
Push your hips back and bend the knees to sit down under control.
Lightly touch the box, keep your chest up, then stand by pushing the floor away.
mistakes: Dropping onto the box instead of lowering under control.

exercises.name: Air Squat
cues: Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out, weight over mid-foot.
Sit down and back, knees tracking in line with the toes, chest tall.
Go as deep as you can with a flat back, then drive up through the whole foot.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold one weight against your chest with both hands, elbows pointing down.
Sit straight down between your knees, keeping the weight close.
Stand tall, squeezing the glutes at the top.
mistakes: Letting the weight drift away from the chest.
Leaning forward and losing the upright chest.

exercises.name: Front Squat
cues: Bar rests on your front shoulders, elbows high, a clean-grip or crossed-arm hold.
Keep the torso upright as you squat down under control.
Drive up, keeping the elbows high the whole way.
mistakes: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward.

exercises.name: Back Squat
cues: Bar sits on your upper back, not your neck; hands grip evenly; brace your trunk.
Sit down and back with knees tracking over toes, to a depth you control.
Drive up through the floor, keeping the chest up and the back flat.
mistakes: Lower back rounding at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Press
cues: Seat set so the knees bend about 90 degrees at the bottom; feet shoulder-width on the plate.
Lower the sled under control without letting the lower back peel off the pad.
Press away without locking the knees hard at the top.
mistakes: Letting the hips curl up off the seat at the bottom.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
cues: Back flat against a wall, feet out in front so the knees are about 90 degrees.
Press the lower back and shoulders into the wall.
Hold, breathing steadily, thighs roughly parallel to the floor.
mistakes: Resting the hands on the thighs.
Sliding so low it becomes uncomfortable on the knees.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
cues: Hold the ball at your chest and squat to at least thigh-parallel.
Stand and throw the ball up at a target in one smooth motion, using the legs to drive it.
Catch it with soft arms and flow into the next squat.
mistakes: Cutting the squat depth short as you tire.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat about hip-width.
Press through the heels and lift the hips until the body is a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower with control.
mistakes: Pushing up by arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.
Feet too far from the hips.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: Lie as for a bridge, one foot on the floor and the other knee pulled toward you.
Press through the planted heel and lift the hips level.
Keep the hips square, lower slowly, then switch sides.
mistakes: Hips twisting or dropping on one side.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back against a bench, a padded bar across your hips, feet flat.
Drive through the heels and lift until the hips are in line with shoulders and knees.
Chin slightly tucked; lower under control.
mistakes: Overextending the lower back at the top.
Feet too close or too far so the hamstrings take over.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
cues: Stand over the kettlebell between your feet, hips back, back flat.
Grip the handle, brace, and stand by pushing the floor away.
Lock the hips and glutes at the top, then hinge back down under control.
mistakes: Squatting the weight up instead of hinging.
Rounding the back as you reach for the handle.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees.
Push the hips back, sliding the weights down your legs with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive the hips forward to stand.
mistakes: Bending the knees so much it becomes a squat.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold the bar at hip height, soft knees, shoulders back.
Hinge the hips back, bar close to the legs, back flat.
Lower to about mid-shin or until the hamstrings stretch, then stand tall.
mistakes: Letting the bar drift away from the legs.

exercises.name: Deadlift
cues: Bar over mid-foot, shins close, grip just outside the legs.
Brace, pull the slack out of the bar, then push the floor away.
Stand tall with the glutes locked; lower by hinging back, bar close to the body.
mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor.
Hips shooting up before the chest.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, weight (if any) in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward, sending the free leg straight back, hips staying level.
Return by driving the hips forward and squeezing the glute.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hinge back with the bell between your legs, then snap the hips forward.
The bell floats to about chest height; arms just guide it.
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping the back flat.
mistakes: Squatting the swing instead of hinging.

exercises.name: Back Extension
cues: Hips supported on the pad, feet anchored.
Lower the torso with a flat back, then lift until the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze the glutes at the top without leaning back.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl
cues: Set the pad just above your heels, hips pinned down.
Curl the heels toward the glutes smoothly.
Lower slowly, keeping the hips on the pad.
mistakes: Lifting the hips to cheat the curl.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
cues: Kneel with your feet held firmly (partner, bench or pad), body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward as slowly as possible, hamstrings resisting.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push back up.
mistakes: Folding at the hips instead of staying straight.
Dropping the whole way rather than resisting.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
cues: Face away from a low cable, rope between your legs.
Hinge back so the rope travels behind you.
Drive the hips forward and squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Good Morning
cues: Hands behind the head (or a light bar on the upper back), soft knees.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Stand by driving the hips forward.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Stand tall, step one foot back and lower until both knees bend about 90 degrees.
Front shin stays roughly vertical, chest up.
Push through the front foot to return, then switch.
mistakes: Taking too short a step so the knee travels far forward.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
cues: Take a long step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push off the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Keep the torso upright and the steps steady.
mistakes: Letting the front knee cave in.

exercises.name: Split Squat
cues: Stand in a long stance, back heel up, both feet pointing forward.
Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press back up without shifting the feet.
mistakes: Stance so short the front knee drifts far over the toes.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
cues: Back foot resting on a bench behind you, front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down, torso tall, front knee tracking over the toes.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench.
Wobbling because the stance is too narrow.

exercises.name: Step-Up
cues: Place the whole foot on a box about knee height.
Drive through that foot to stand tall on the box.
Lower back down slowly rather than dropping.
mistakes: A box so high that the form falls apart.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
cues: Step wide to one side, sit back into that hip, other leg straight.
Keep the toes pointing forward and the chest up.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing.
mistakes: Letting the bent knee cave in.
Rounding the back to reach lower.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
cues: Step one foot back and across behind the other leg.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel, hips square.
Drive through the front foot to come back up.

exercises.name: Sandbag Lunge
cues: Carry the sandbag high on your shoulders or in a bear hug.
Step forward into a lunge until the back knee lightly touches down.
Drive up and step through, keeping a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Letting the bag slide forward and pull the torso down.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
cues: Hands on a wall at shoulder height, body in a straight line, feet back.
Bend the elbows and bring your chest toward the wall.
Press away until the arms are straight.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Hands on a bench or sturdy box, body in one straight line.
Lower the chest to the edge with elbows about 45 degrees from the body.
Press back up without letting the hips sag.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
cues: Knees on the floor, body straight from knees to head.
Lower the chest toward the floor, elbows about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Push-Up
cues: Hands under the shoulders, body in a straight plank.
Lower until the chest nearly touches the floor, elbows about 45 degrees.
Press up, keeping the body one rigid line.

exercises.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
cues: Feet on a bench or box, hands on the floor under the shoulders.
Keep the body in a straight line as you lower the chest.
Press up without letting the hips drop.

exercises.name: Archer Push-Up
cues: Wide hand position, body in a plank.
Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight to the side.
Push back up and alternate sides.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
cues: Hips high in an inverted V, hands shoulder-width.
Bend the elbows to lower the top of the head toward the floor between the hands.
Press back up to the V.
mistakes: Hips dropping so it becomes a regular push-up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Lie on a bench, dumbbells at chest level, feet planted, shoulder blades pulled back.
Press the weights up until the arms are straight over the chest.
Lower slowly to the sides of the chest.
mistakes: Bouncing the weights off the chest.
Lifting the hips off the bench.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Lie with eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinched, feet planted.
Unrack, lower the bar to the lower chest with elbows about 45-60 degrees.
Press up to straight arms. Use a spotter or safety arms for heavy sets.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the bench.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Bench at a low-to-moderate incline, dumbbells at the upper chest.
Press up and slightly together until arms are straight.
Lower slowly to the sides of the chest.
mistakes: Setting the bench too steep so it becomes a shoulder press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, ribs down, glutes tight.
Press overhead until the arms are straight, biceps by the ears.
Lower under control back to the shoulders.
mistakes: Pressing forward instead of straight up.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
cues: Bar at the collarbone, grip just outside the shoulders, glutes and abs tight.
Press the bar straight up, moving the head back then through as it passes.
Lock out overhead, then lower to the collarbone.
mistakes: Leaning back and turning it into an incline press.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
cues: Hold the end of a barbell anchored in a corner at shoulder height.
Press up and slightly forward until the arm is straight.
Lower under control; keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
cues: Hands on a bench behind you, legs out in front.
Bend the elbows straight back to lower the body about 90 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
mistakes: Shoulders rolling forward at the bottom.

exercises.name: Dip
cues: Support yourself on parallel bars, shoulders down.
Lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor, leaning slightly forward for chest.
Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Dropping too deep with shoulders rolled forward.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
cues: Cables set at chest height, a slight bend in the elbows.
Bring the hands together in a wide arc in front of the chest.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
mistakes: Straightening and bending the elbows like a press.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
cues: Elbows tucked at your sides, grip a rope or bar at a high cable.
Press down until the arms are straight.
Return slowly without letting the elbows drift forward.
mistakes: Elbows swinging away from the body.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Hold a band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull it apart by squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, keeping the arms level.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
cues: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Without bending the elbows, pull the shoulder blades down and back to lift slightly.
Relax back to a full hang.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
cues: Lie under a low bar or rings, body in a straight line, heels on the floor.
Pull the chest to the bar, elbows close to the body.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Pulling with the neck rather than the back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
cues: One hand and knee on a bench (or a hinged stance), flat back.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close to the body.
Lower under control to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
cues: Hinge to a flat-back position, bar hanging at arm's length.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, elbows close.
Lower slowly, keeping the torso still.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with a slight knee bend, arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Return slowly without leaning far forward.
mistakes: Rocking the torso to move the weight.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Grip slightly wider than the shoulders, thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to the upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Return slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
cues: Use a band or assist machine so you can complete the full range.
Start from a hang and pull the chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Using too much assistance and cutting the range.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
cues: Overhand grip a little wider than the shoulders, start from a full hang.
Pull until the chin clears the bar, elbows going down and back.
Lower under control to straight arms.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
cues: Underhand grip about shoulder-width, full hang.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Face Pull
cues: Rope or band at upper-chest height, step back with arms straight.
Pull toward your face, elbows high and wide, hands finishing by the ears.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
cues: Hinge forward, dumbbells hanging, soft elbows.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
cues: Elbows at your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up without moving the elbows.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
cues: Palms facing each other, elbows at your sides.
Curl up keeping the wrists straight.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Backpack Row
cues: Fill a backpack with books or bottles and hold it by the top handle or straps.
Hinge forward with a flat back and let it hang at arm's length.
Pull it to your lower ribs, elbow close to the body, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Standing up to swing the bag.

exercises.name: Backpack Curl
cues: Hold a loaded backpack by the top handle or hug the straps in one hand.
Curl it up keeping the elbow at your side.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
cues: Lie face down, arms by your sides, lifting the chest slightly.
Sweep the straight arms out and up overhead in a wide arc, then back to the hips.
Keep the neck long and the movement slow.

exercises.name: Floor Back Extension
cues: Lie face down, arms extended overhead.
Lift the arms, chest and legs a little off the floor together, squeezing the glutes.
Hold a second, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting high and pinching the lower back.

exercises.name: Y Raise
cues: Lie face down, arms overhead in a Y, thumbs up.
Lift the arms a little off the floor by squeezing the upper back.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Farmers Carry
cues: Stand tall holding a heavy weight in each hand at your sides.
Walk with short, quick steps, shoulders back, ribs down.
Don't lean or let the weights swing; set them down with a flat back.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
cues: Hold one heavy weight at your side.
Walk upright without leaning toward or away from the weight.
Switch hands halfway.
mistakes: Leaning sideways to offset the load.

exercises.name: Front Rack Carry
cues: Hold a bell at your collarbone, elbow tucked in.
Walk tall and slowly, ribs stacked over the hips.
Switch sides or hold two for a heavier version.
mistakes: Leaning back to balance the weight.

exercises.name: Overhead Carry
cues: Press one weight overhead and lock the arm out by the ear.
Walk with the ribs down and the weight stacked over the shoulder.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: Sandbag Carry
cues: Hug the sandbag to your chest or carry it on one shoulder.
Walk with short steps, trunk braced.
Keep the bag close; put it down with a flat back.

exercises.name: Sled Push
cues: Hands on the sled uprights, body at a strong forward lean, arms straight.
Drive with the legs in short, powerful steps.
Keep the back flat and the head in line; keep it moving rather than stopping and starting.
mistakes: Standing too upright so the sled stalls.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
cues: Face the sled holding the rope or straps, stance wide and low.
Pull hand over hand (or walk backward) keeping the chest up.
Keep the rope tight and the back flat throughout.
mistakes: Leaning far back and using only the arms.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, hips and knees at 90 degrees.
Press the lower back gently into the floor.
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor, then return and switch.
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
cues: On hands and knees, back flat.
Reach the opposite arm and leg out until level with the torso.
Hold a second without twisting, then switch.

exercises.name: Knee Plank
cues: Forearms on the floor, knees down, body straight from knees to head.
Brace the abs and squeeze the glutes.
Breathe steadily; stop when the form slips.

exercises.name: Plank
cues: Forearms under the shoulders, body in a straight line.
Squeeze the glutes and pull the ribs toward the pelvis.
Breathe; end the set when the hips sag.
mistakes: Looking up and straining the neck.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
cues: Start in a high plank, feet a bit wider than usual.
Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder without letting the hips rotate.
Alternate, keeping the body still.

exercises.name: Side Plank
cues: Lie on your side, forearm under the shoulder, feet stacked.
Lift the hips so the body is one straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
cues: Lie on your back, press the lower back into the floor.
Lift the shoulders and straightened legs a few inches off the floor.
Hold with the ribs down; bend the knees to make it easier.
mistakes: Lower back arching away from the floor.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Hang from a bar, shoulders engaged.
Raise the knees toward the chest by curling the pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang with straight arms, shoulders engaged.
Raise straight legs toward the bar by curling the pelvis.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Kneel with the wheel under the shoulders, brace the abs.
Roll forward only as far as you can keep the lower back flat.
Pull back using the abs, not the hips.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
cues: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height, hands at the chest.
Press straight out and resist being pulled toward the anchor.
Hold a second, bring the hands back in.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
cues: Sit leaning back slightly, chest tall, feet down or lifted.
Rotate the torso side to side, moving the shoulders and ribs.
Keep the spine long; hold a weight for more.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Lie on your back, hands lightly by the head.
Bring the opposite elbow toward the opposite knee as the other leg extends.
Alternate slowly, controlling each side.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
cues: Lie with knees bent, arms crossed or by the head.
Curl the torso up toward the knees.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent over the hips.
Curl the pelvis up off the floor, bringing the knees toward the chest.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: V-Up
cues: Lie flat, arms overhead.
Lift the legs and the torso together, reaching hands toward the toes.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
cues: Kneel below a high cable with a rope by the head.
Curl the ribs toward the pelvis, not just bending at the hips.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Hinging at the hips instead of curling.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
cues: On hands and feet with the knees hovering just off the floor.
Move opposite hand and foot together, back flat.
Keep the hips low and level.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
cues: High plank, hands under the shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the chest, then switch quickly.
Keep the hips level and the shoulders over the hands.
mistakes: Bouncing the hips up and down.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
cues: Start with feet together, arms by the sides.
Jump the feet out as the arms go overhead.
Jump back; land softly.

exercises.name: Squat Jump
cues: Squat to a comfortable depth.
Jump up as high as you can, extending fully.
Land softly into the next squat.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
cues: Swing the arms back and sit the hips back.
Jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly in a squat, then reset.

exercises.name: Box Jump
cues: Stand a short distance from a sturdy box.
Swing the arms and jump, landing softly with both feet fully on the box.
Stand tall, then step down rather than jumping down.
mistakes: A box too high for good form.

exercises.name: Burpee
cues: From standing, place hands down and step or jump the feet back to a plank.
Lower the chest to the floor if doing the full version, then press up.
Jump the feet in and finish with a small jump.
mistakes: Sagging the lower back in the plank.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jump
cues: Do a burpee, then immediately broad jump forward.
Land softly and go straight into the next burpee.
Keep a pace you can hold; the distance is what counts.

exercises.name: Skater Hop
cues: Bound sideways from one foot to the other.
Land softly on the outside foot, other leg swinging behind.
Keep the hips low and the knee over the toes.

exercises.name: Tuck Jump
cues: Jump straight up and pull the knees toward the chest.
Land softly and reset before the next.
Keep the chest tall.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunge
cues: Lunge down, then jump and switch legs in the air.
Land softly in the opposite lunge.
Keep the torso upright.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Slam
cues: Lift the ball overhead, rising onto the toes.
Slam it down hard in front of you, hinging at the hips.
Pick it up with a flat back and repeat.
mistakes: Rounding the back when picking it up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
cues: Hold dumbbells at the shoulders and squat.
Drive up and use the momentum to press the weights overhead.
Lower to the shoulders and flow into the next squat.
mistakes: Pressing before the legs finish driving.

exercises.name: Barbell Thruster
cues: Front-rack the bar and squat.
Stand explosively and press the bar overhead in one motion.
Lower to the front rack and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Snatch
cues: Dumbbell between the feet, hinge back with a flat spine.
Drive the hips and pull the weight in a close, straight path overhead.
Lock out overhead, lower it back under control.
mistakes: Pulling with the arm instead of the hips.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Clean
cues: Hinge back with the bell between the legs, then snap the hips forward.
Pull the elbow in and let the bell rotate softly to the front-rack position.
Lower it back under control.
mistakes: Banging the forearm as the bell flips.
Curling it up with the arm.

exercises.name: Power Clean
cues: Set up like a deadlift, bar close to the shins.
Pull up past the knees, then extend the hips powerfully and pull under the bar.
Catch it on the front shoulders in a quarter squat; learn it with a coach.
mistakes: Bar swinging away from the body.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Snatch
cues: Swing the bell back between the legs.
Drive the hips and pull the bell up close to the body and punch through at the top.
Lock out overhead; lower it back down into the swing.
mistakes: Letting the bell crash onto the forearm.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
cues: Stand on the balls of your feet, ideally with the heels over the edge of a step.
Rise as high as you can.
Lower slowly past the starting height for a full stretch.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
cues: Balance on one foot on a step, hand lightly on a wall.
Rise onto the toes, then lower slowly below the step.
Complete the set then switch.
mistakes: Rolling to the outside of the foot.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: Knees under the pad, balls of the feet on the platform.
Raise the heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Machine Calf Raise
cues: Shoulders under the pads, balls of the feet on the platform.
Rise high on the toes.
Lower slowly through the full range.

exercises.name: Pogo Hop
cues: Stand tall, knees slightly bent.
Hop quickly using only the ankles, staying light on the toes.
Keep each contact short and quiet.

exercises.name: Clamshell
cues: Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together.
Keeping the feet together, open the top knee without rolling the pelvis back.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
cues: Band around the thighs or ankles, slight squat.
Step sideways keeping tension on the band.
Keep the toes forward; don't let the knees cave in.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lie on your side, bottom leg bent for balance.
Lift the top leg slightly behind the body.
Lower slowly without rolling back.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
cues: On hands and knees, back flat.
Lift one knee out to the side without twisting.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
cues: Sit with the pads on the outside of the knees, back supported.
Press the knees out smoothly.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
cues: Take a wide stance, toes slightly out.
Shift your weight over one leg and sit deep while the other leg straightens, toes up.
Push back through the bent leg to the middle and switch.

exercises.name: Run
cues: Stand tall with a slight forward lean from the ankles.
Land under the body with a quick, relaxed cadence.
Settle into a pace where you can hold the form.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
cues: Strap in, shins vertical, arms straight, back tall.
Drive with the legs first, then lean back slightly, then pull the handle to the lower ribs.
Return in reverse: arms, body, then legs.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms before the legs.

exercises.name: SkiErg
cues: Stand tall, handles at the forehead, slight knee bend.
Pull down by hinging at the hips and bending the knees while driving the arms to the thighs.
Let the handles rise with the body and repeat in a rhythm.

exercises.name: Assault Bike
cues: Adjust the seat so the knees are nearly straight at the bottom.
Push and pull the handles while pedalling.
Pace it: it punishes starting too hard.
mistakes: Setting off at a sprint you cannot sustain.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
cues: Elbows by the ribs, turn the rope with the wrists.
Hop just high enough to clear the rope on the balls of the feet.
Keep a steady rhythm and relaxed shoulders.

exercises.name: Incline Walk
cues: Set a steady incline and pace you can hold.
Walk tall without holding the rails.
Swing the arms naturally.
mistakes: Gripping the rails and leaning back.

exercises.name: Shuttle Run
cues: Mark two lines 10-20 m apart.
Sprint to one, touch the line, sprint back.
Decelerate in short steps and turn low.

exercises.name: A-Skip
cues: Skip forward, driving one knee up to hip height as you hop.
Opposite arm swings with the lifted knee.
Land on the ball of the foot, quick and light.

exercises.name: High Knees
cues: Run on the spot, lifting the knees to about hip height.
Pump the arms, stay tall and light on the toes.
Keep a fast, quiet cadence.

exercises.name: Strides
cues: On a flat surface, accelerate smoothly to a quick but relaxed pace over 15-25 s.
Stay tall and loose; do not sprint flat out.
Walk back to recover fully between strides.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
cues: Jog forward flicking the heels toward the glutes.
Keep the thighs mostly pointing down and the torso tall.
Stay light and quick.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
cues: Step into a deep lunge, hands inside the front foot.
Rotate the torso and reach the inside arm up toward the ceiling.
Lower, straighten the front knee to stretch the hamstring, then step through.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
cues: On hands and knees, hands under shoulders.
Round the back and tuck the chin, then arch and lift the chest.
Move slowly with your breathing.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation
cues: Lie on your side, knees bent, arms stretched out in front.
Rotate the top arm up and back, following with your eyes.
Return slowly and repeat.
mistakes: Letting the knees lift off each other.

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 Switch
cues: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one in front and one to the side.
Rotate the knees to the other side without using the hands if you can.
Keep the torso tall.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
cues: Kneel on one knee with a cushion, other foot forward.
Tuck the pelvis and gently shift the hips forward.
Hold, breathing, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Ankle Mobility Rock
cues: Face a wall in a split stance, front foot a hand-length away.
Drive the front knee forward over the toes keeping the heel down.
Return and repeat.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
cues: From hands and knees, lift the hips up and back into an inverted V.
Press the floor away, heels reaching toward the floor.
Bend the knees slightly if the back rounds.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
cues: From a plank or all fours, bring one knee forward and angle the shin.
Lower the hips toward the floor and fold forward.
Breathe; stop short of sharp knee pain.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes out, sink into a deep squat.
Hold your hands together in front, elbows pushing the knees out.
Keep the chest up and heels down.

exercises.name: Band Shoulder Dislocate
cues: Hold a band wide in front of the thighs.
Raise it overhead and behind you with straight arms.
Return; widen the grip if it feels tight.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch
cues: Hands on a wall, one leg back with the heel down.
Lean forward until you feel the calf stretch.
Hold, then switch.
